questions.questionText:
The Norwegian government chose to spend the profits from oil on stocks, bonds and property.
The possibility of improving domestic infrastructure, therefore, was not taken.
Which economic concept does this best illustrate?
What would be classified by an economist as the factor of production known as land?

options.text: a discovery of oil in the South China sea
an oil rig bought by an oil company
money held by the oil companies in their bank accounts

questions.questionText: What is the cause of the economic problem facing all countries?

options.text: uneven distribution of income and wealth
unlimited wants in relation to limited resources

questions.questionText: Which activity takes place in the tertiary sector?

In the diagram, suppliers have set the price of a product at P . Economic theory predicts that the
equilibrium price of the product will rise to P .
price
quantity
What is the reason for this movement in price?

options.text: Demand for the product will increase.
No more of the product can be supplied.
Some consumers are willing to pay higher prices.

questions.questionText:
A government approved the construction of a new railway line connecting major cities. It would be
built by a private company but be funded partly through taxation. It would create many jobs.
People living on the route worried about the harm to their environment.
Which concepts are directly involved in this statement?
What is a function of a central bank?
What is likely to lead to an increase in the wages of university lecturers?

options.text: an increase in the fringe benefits provided to university lecturers
an increase in the tuition fees paid by university students
government policies reducing the length of the training for university lecturers
increased demand from students to study at university

questions.questionText: When is a trade union likely to have more power to increase its members’ wages?

The table shows the percentage (%) of income saved by different age groups.
age (years) 15–29 30–39 40–49 50–64 65+
% of income saved –30 –5 +15 +30 –10
What can be concluded from the table?

options.text: Over the age range shown total savings equalled total dissavings.
The 15–29 age group has the lowest level of income.
The 50–64 age group saves the highest percentage of its income.
The 65+ age group has a lower income than the 30–39 age group.

questions.questionText: Which characteristic can exist both in monopoly and in perfect competition?

An industry is experiencing diseconomies of scale.
What will be happening to long run average cost and total cost?
long run
total cost
average cost

A firm that sells its product for $6 a unit has the following total costs.
output (units) 0 10 20 30
total costs ($) 40 100 120 150
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Average cost is lowest when 10 units are produced.
The firm does not make any profit when 20 units are sold.
The firm has no fixed costs.
Total variable costs fall continuously over these outputs.

questions.questionText: Which statement about fixed costs is correct?

options.text: They exist only in the long run.
They include raw material and direct labour costs.
They increase at the same rate as output.
They must be paid even if there is no output.

questions.questionText:
What would a government reduce as part of an expansionary monetary policy to increase
employment?
What is an aim of government policy?

The table shows the amount of tax to be paid at different weekly incomes.
weekly income ($) 100 150 200 250
weekly tax ($) 20 30 36 40
Which statement describes the system of income tax as income rises over this range?

options.text: It is proportional then becomes progressive.
It is proportional then becomes regressive.

questions.questionText:
Which situation involving the building industry is most likely to be investigated by a government
body set up to control restrictive practices?

options.text: a builder purchasing a plot of land for development of housing
groups of suppliers of building materials agreeing to fix prices
several builders bidding for the same contracts
several builders using different sources of supply

questions.questionText:
An economy is experiencing two consecutive quarters of negative economic growth.
What is this economy experiencing?
What is included in the calculation of a consumer prices index (CPI)?

options.text: the price of a basket of goods and services
the price of exports and the price of imports
the value of the currency on international markets

questions.questionText:
There was a fall in investment spending by businesses in the third quarter of 2015.
What would be the likely result of this?

The table shows units of output, value of output and number of people employed in an industry
over three years.
output output value number employed
(units, millions) ($ millions) (000)
year 1 10 10 5
year 2 21 25 7
year 3 32 40 8
What can be concluded from the table?
What is found in a typical developed country?
Which characteristic will show that a country has significant absolute poverty?

options.text: A majority of the population will have less than average income.
Basic living needs are not being met.
Most people do not have mobile phones.
There is a high number of people living in rural areas.

questions.questionText:
The government of a developing country allows a multinational mining company to mine minerals
in order to improve the standard of living of the local people.
Which action by the multinational company (MNC) will not lead to an improvement in the
standard of living of the local people?

A country has decided that it wants to increase free trade with its trading partners.
Which measure would help it achieve this objective?

options.text: a higher quota on imported cars
a subsidy to domestic car producers
an embargo on cars produced in other countries

questions.questionText:
In 2012 the UK held the Olympic Games, which attracted a large number of visitors from foreign
countries.
Which item of the UK’s current account balance will have benefited directly from this event?

The Mexican currency (the peso) has fallen in value against the US dollar.
What will be the effect of this on the Mexican economy?

options.text: a decrease in tariffs on imports
a decrease in the price of exports
a decrease in the price of imports
a decrease in the volume of exports

rice yield
country

options.text: Bangladesh and Thailand produce the same amount of rice.
Japan produces more than three times as much rice as Bangladesh.
Japan produces the largest amount of rice per hectare.
